exposure: Preterm preeclampsia superimposed on chronic hypertension (SI)
Term preeclampsia superimposed on chronic hypertension (SI)
cohort: Pregnant people with hypertensive disorders affecting singleton, euploid gestations and non-hypertensive control subjects from the University of Michigan Biorepository for Understanding Maternal and Pediatric Health.
finding: Preeclampsia superimposed on chronic hypertension (SI) was molecularly distinct from preeclampsia (PreE) in individuals without chronic hypertension, and from chronic hypertension without preeclampsia, suggesting that SI may represent a distinct entity with unique placental transcriptional profiles.
